area: Runtime Verification Claims vs Dual-Snapshot Limits
conflicting_sources: Phase A2 10MB/20MB claims vs physical Salesforce platform limits
authoritative_source: Salesforce Metadata and DAGraphChunkService / DAGraphController implementation
evidence: DA_Graph_Chunk__c.Payload_Data__c is Long Text Area (131,072 chars). Controller fetches chunks in batches of 10 under USER_MODE. Browser memory limits prohibit dual Cytoscape instances. Request cancellation is strictly client-side stale request token invalidation.
